## Daily Sleep Apnea Events
- Over the past two weeks, daily sleep apnea events ranged from 1 to 2 times.
- Most days (10 out of 14) had exactly 1 event; 4 days (March 18, 23, 26, 30) recorded 2 events.
- No clear increasing or decreasing trend was observed; multiple events occurred sporadically and not on consecutive days.
- Days with 2 apnea events were associated with lower sleep scores (74, 35, 76, 58), suggesting a possible link between higher apnea frequency and poorer sleep quality.

## Weekly Total Step Count

- Average daily sleep duration was 456 minutes (7h 36m), with a range from 440 minutes (7h 20m, March 24) to 475 minutes (7h 55m, March 28), a variation of 35 minutes.

- Day-to-day fluctuations were minor, indicating a consistent sleep routine with no drastic changes.
- No clear weekly pattern emerged, but durations were longer mid-week (March 26–28) compared to the start and end of the period.
